content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I'm experiencing an odd issue with a threshold trigger on a [article_no] DC24v [product_name]. My water pulse counter is connected to I6 and counts correctly (80 pulses per liter), with the input linked to a threshold trigger measuring over 4 seconds. In my simulation, setting I6 to a frequency of 80 yields 320, but when running the program on the actual module and letting the water flow at about one liter per minute, I only get a frequency of 6 on the threshold trigger. Am I missing something? I tried searching the forum but haven't found a solution yet. Thanks a lot.
Are you using the "High speed input"? Normally, inputs are limited to a maximum of 4 Hz according to the manual, which matches your observed value.

[user_name], the issue with the built-in threshold trigger is that you can't control when the sampling time starts or stops. It might be better to design your own threshold trigger or use another technique.
Hello, Which [product_name] model do you have? Some versions cannot handle fast pulses efficiently.

Details about the module are in my first post: [product_name] 12/24 RCEO [article_no]. My pulse input is on I6, also mentioned earlier. Creating my own threshold trigger seems to work, but I'm still curious about what was going wrong with the original function.
Could you please share your program?

Hi, Your first post only mentions a [product_name] 8 24V. There are various [product_name] 8 versions with 24V power supply. If you do have a [product_name] 8 12/24 RCEO, it includes 4 high-speed counters on inputs I3 to I6. Does your sensor meet the technical requirements? Your setup appears correct. If your sensor produces 80 pulses per liter and you have 1 liter per second, you should see 320 pulses in 4 seconds. If you adjust the scan time of the threshold to 1 second, does it display 80 pulses? Hope this helps.
